profile.name: Md Hanif Alam
profile.tagline: I turn raw footage into stories that move — edits, motion graphics and reels that keep people watching.
about: I've been editing since 2015 — starting as a freelance video editor and growing into motion design, kinetic typography and short-form content.
Every cut has a job: to hold attention, to make a feeling land, or to make an idea easy to understand. I care about rhythm, clean type and sound that sits right with the picture.
Today I work as a freelance video editor and motion designer, helping creators and brands turn their footage into reels, promos and showreels.

services.text: Story-first cuts for YouTube, promos, events and brand films.
